description: This file declares structures, constants, and function prototypes related to bitmap indexing and traversal in a version control system, likely Git.

classes.name: bitmap_disk_header
classes.description: Structure representing the header of a bitmap stored on disk, including signature, version, options, entry count, and checksum.

classes.name: bitmapped_pack
classes.description: Structure representing a pack with bitmap information, including position, number, and associated multi-pack index.

classes.name: bitmap_index
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a bitmap index used for commit and object reachability analysis.

classes.name: list_objects_filter_options
classes.description: Opaque structure for filtering options when listing objects in bitmap traversal.

classes.name: bitmap_writer
classes.description: Structure for writing and managing bitmap data, including references to repository, bitmaps, progress, and checksum.

methods.name: prepare_bitmap_git
methods.description: Prepares a bitmap index for a given repository.

methods.name: prepare_midx_bitmap_git
methods.description: Prepares a multi-pack index bitmap for a given multi-pack index.

methods.name: bitmap_index_contains_pack
methods.description: Checks if a bitmap index contains a specific pack.

methods.name: count_bitmap_commit_list
methods.description: Counts commits, trees, blobs, and tags in a bitmap index.

methods.name: traverse_bitmap_commit_list
methods.description: Traverses the commit list in a bitmap index, applying a callback function.

methods.name: test_bitmap_walk
methods.description: Tests bitmap walk functionality.

methods.description: Tests bitmap commits in a repository.

methods.description: Tests bitmap commits with offset in a repository.

methods.name: test_bitmap_hashes
methods.description: Tests bitmap hashes in a repository.

methods.description: Tests pseudo merge functionality in bitmaps.

methods.name: test_bitmap_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Tests pseudo merge commits in a repository.

methods.name: test_bitmap_pseudo_merge_objects
methods.description: Tests pseudo merge objects in a repository.

methods.name: for_each_bitmapped_object
methods.description: Iterates over objects in a bitmap index, applying a callback.

methods.name: prepare_bitmap_walk
methods.description: Prepares a bitmap walk for a revision list.

methods.name: reuse_partial_packfile_from_bitmap
methods.description: Reuses partial pack files from a bitmap.

methods.name: rebuild_existing_bitmaps
methods.description: Rebuilds existing bitmaps based on provided data.

methods.name: free_bitmap_index
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a bitmap index.

methods.name: bitmap_walk_contains
methods.description: Checks if a bitmap contains a specific object ID.

methods.description: Checks if an object ID is in the uninteresting set of a bitmap index.

methods.name: get_disk_usage_from_bitmap
methods.description: Calculates disk usage from a bitmap index.

methods.description: Builds a type index for bitmap writer.

methods.description: Checks if a bitmap writer has a specific object ID.

methods.description: Pushes a commit into the bitmap writer.

methods.description: Rebuilds a bitmap from source.
